explainer_content.short_definition: Regional Mexican and corrido-rooted music where narrative, acoustic timbre, and pop crossover meet.
explainer_content.history_capsule: From corrido storytelling and norteño roots to Selena, Los Tigres del Norte, and Peso Pluma, the route tracks Mexican regional identity becoming mainstream discovery.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It shows that global pop crossover can come from regional forms without erasing their local narrative and instrumental codes.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The strongest signals are story, regional instrumentation, and vocal phrasing rather than club rhythm or tropical dance.
